candidate: PBOC Shanghai Same-City Data Centre — Jindianyun Retrofit

selected_geometry.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped Shanghai Bill Clearing Centre building at the project’s host property. It is a host-property locator for the proposed Jindianyun/PBOC retrofit, not an official surveyed parcel, campus boundary, data-hall footprint, construction boundary or entrance.
selected_geometry.identity_review: The October10 PBOC design tender identifies the Jindianyun Shanghai campus and proposed main-building retrofit at1581 Zhenguang Road. Putuo Archives explicitly gives1581 Zhenguang Road for Shanghai Bill Clearing Centre; native OSM way957024148 bears that exact historical property name. The October10 tender describes a main building with auxiliary/outdoor areas. The selected point stays inside the mapped named host building and is labelled for the host property, with no inference that the community polygon equals the legal campus or the future machine-room area. The four surrounding named roads are consistent with the official address and broad boundary directions. A corporate-renaming/legal-ownership relationship is not inferred from the address bridge.
selected_geometry.uncertainty_reason: The community map supplies no measured positional accuracy or verified displacement to future machine rooms. Decimal precision is not survey accuracy.

point_method: Midpoint of native WGS84 longitude and latitude extrema using Decimal; independent ray-casting containment check. No coordinate conversion, imagery tracing or image registration.
road_context: Host building west of Zhenguang, north of Caoan, east of Wanzhen and south of Jintang; no survey-boundary offsets evaluated or asserted.
identity_scope: Exact address bridges historical mapped host name and current campus; legal corporate succession/ownership is not claimed.
rights: OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL-1.0. Original government HTML captures remain ignored and are not redistributed.
